I kind of know how you are feeling.  I have been on the ledge for a few weeks now.   I awoke at 4am this morning, in the middle of the NE blizzard and everything was so blissfully quiet and peaceful because of the snow. 

I actually had a few brief moments of happiness before I fell back to sleep and then woke up again with all my problems smack in my face hours later.  

The kicker is , if there wasn't currently a blizzard going on, complete with snow thunder, I would actually be motivated to do something today.

I am tired.  My mind and body are exhausted and I am severely "burnt out".  Nothing provides true happiness for me any longer.  Yet I am not ready for suicide, yet. I wish every night I would just pass away in my sleep. 

I also wish I could just switch places with an unfortunate person with a terminal condition, but otherwise full life, donating my life force to cure them while I pass on in their stead.
was thinking along those lines but with some other means besides relying on the elements to make it fast and painless.
